input.trigger_text: Customer C08623 message: 'I never made this $49.00 purchase. Please check my card.' Refers to 3530164.

hypotheses.title: Legitimate Recurring Customer Behavior
hypotheses.description: Transaction represents routine customer spending consistent with established history.

hypotheses.title: Unauthorized Third-Party Fraud
hypotheses.description: Transaction was conducted by an unauthorized party.

hypotheses.title: Historical Card Compromise Precedent
hypotheses.description: Card credentials may have been cloned or compromised in an earlier breach.

hypotheses.title: Shared Device / Connected Account Activity
hypotheses.description: Activity initiated from a shared or compromised device profile.
contradicting_evidence: Graph queries indicate no multi-account device syndicate.

hypotheses.title: Shared Billing Region Activity
hypotheses.description: Activity associated with shared geographic billing region.
supporting_evidence: Billing region exists in regional dataset.
contradicting_evidence: Regional code alone does not constitute coordinated fraud ring.

hypotheses.title: Connected Cards Ring
hypotheses.description: Associated cards sharing credentials or accounts.
contradicting_evidence: Zero connected cards discovered in graph queries.

hypotheses.title: Coordinated Abuse / Rapid Velocity
hypotheses.description: High velocity botting or rapid sequence abuse.
contradicting_evidence: Transaction sequence analysis shows normal velocity.

hypotheses.title: Insufficient Evidence / Authorization Unknown
hypotheses.description: Authorization cannot be confirmed without cardholder communication.
supporting_evidence: Customer validation outreach request pending. Cardholder authorization status is unknown.
Inbound customer message reported transaction as unrecognized/unauthorized.
contradicting_evidence: Formal customer validation response is pending; customer response status is unknown.
Cardholder identity and authorization unverified by direct outreach.
